pr.body:
Currently StreamDeserializer only supports objects and arrays, because it couldn't handle things like `truefalse` properly before. This PR changes the behavior of the parser so that it checks after parsing an identifier whether there's any trailing characters that aren't one of ` \n\t\r"[]{},:` or EOF, and if there is it will give an error. This means it will error immediately when parsing `truefalse` instead of first emitting `true` followed by an error.

Related: https://github.com/serde-rs/json/pull/301

cc @dtolnay
